purpose: Produce at least 20 distinct executable Temporal benchmark families from sources first made public between 2026-01-01 and 2026-09-03.
interpretation: Non-comparative benchmark production run. It does not estimate the causal effect of the revised authoring pipeline and does not modify EXP-TEMPORAL-AUTHORING-001.

source_policy.order: Nature and Science sources that pass TeX availability and either exact-DOI linkage or the preregistered full-title search with official-record adjudication, followed by existing eligible Physical Review Letters source packets

time_window.date_rule: earliest_public_date is the earlier of journal publication and arXiv first submission

target.rule: Count one family only after a nonempty minimal ScienceCard, separate-context source review retention, deterministic construction, and passing Identification and Discovery known-truth validation.
target.processing: Process the complete frozen cohort; do not replace failed sources after observing authoring or review outcomes.

authoring_engine.runtime_model_label: unknown unless exposed by the session

review.execution: A separate Code Agent context reviews each fixed source packet and frozen ScienceCard.
review.independence_claim: Process separation only; this is not independent human or domain-expert review.
review.release_requirement: Human source review remains required before public benchmark release.

temporal_claim.reason: The authoring engine knowledge cutoff and immutable snapshot are not documented.
temporal_claim.prohibited_description: Post-cutoff, unseen, or contamination-free benchmark cases

arxiv_linkage.primary_rule: Exact canonical DOI using official journal and arXiv metadata.
arxiv_linkage.supplemental_recall: For automatic not-found, ambiguous, markup-title, or truncated results, use a full-title web search only to discover candidates, then adjudicate with DOI, title, authors, and abstract from official journal and arXiv records.
